description: A React component class for displaying and managing a list of channels with pagination, filtering, and search functionalities in the Mattermost admin console.

classes.name: ChannelList
classes.description: A React.PureComponent class that manages and displays a list of channels with pagination, filtering, and search features.

methods.name: componentDidMount
methods.description: Initial load of channels when component mounts.

methods.name: loadPage
methods.description: Loads a specific page of channels, optionally with a specified page size.

methods.name: nextPage
methods.description: Advances to the next page of channels.

methods.name: previousPage
methods.description: Goes back to the previous page of channels.

methods.name: getVisibleTotalCount
methods.description: Calculates total number of channels considering additions and removals.

methods.name: getPaginationProps
methods.description: Returns pagination display info: start, end, total counts.

methods.name: removeChannel
methods.description: Removes a channel from the list and updates pagination accordingly.

methods.name: getColumns
methods.description: Defines columns for the data grid.

methods.name: getRows
methods.description: Generates rows for the data grid based on current channels, filters, and pagination.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Handles search input and updates channel list.

methods.name: componentDidUpdate
methods.description: Handles updates to props, triggers data reloads on filter or search changes.

methods.name: searchDebounced
methods.description: Debounced search function to optimize search calls.

methods.name: onFilter
methods.description: Handles filter changes and updates filter state.
